title: Rebello's tweet promising to open Brazil's UFO archives if the US does

tellings.quote: I know what the armed forces have in their archives. What I can say is that if the US government reveals its documents, I will do the same if I am elected president of Brazil.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, quotes a post on social media by Aldo Rebello, presented as a former Brazilian defence minister, from around 2025 or 2026. In it Rebello says he knows what Brazil's armed forces hold in their UFO archives, and that if the US government reveals its documents, he will do the same if he is elected president of Brazil.
